title: Til Tuesday - Everything's Different Now Album Cover
coreRelationships: The central figure (woman with guitar) is the primary subject, positioned slightly left of center.
The drummer and other objects are arranged around the central figure, creating a balanced yet eclectic composition.
The dark background provides strong contrast for the brightly colored and textured foreground elements.
The 'Til Tuesday' title is fragmented and scattered across the top, while the album title is handwritten at the bottom.
